name: Welfare Services for Women
benefit:
> **Shelter & Protection:**

- Establishment of Working Women Hostels.
- Short Stay Homes for women and girls.

> **Financial Support:**

- Assistance to widows without income.
- Support for women in distress.

> **Skill Development & Livelihood:**

  - Vocational training programmes.
  - Training-cum-production centres.
  - Support for self-employment.

> **Support Services:**

- Legal ai
_eligibility_text: The following individual types of applicants are eligible under this scheme: - Widows without family or financial support - Women facing domestic violence - Trafficked or rescued women/girls - Women affected by natural disasters - Women with HIV/AIDS - Economically backward women - Women labourers, including domestic workers
